## Annex 2 — Draft supplemental judicial affidavit (if leave is sought)

Same caption. Same preliminary statement and attestation form as the 23 January 2026 affidavit; examined by Atty. Barandon; sworn before a notary; attestation by counsel under the Judicial Affidavit Rule. Offered to supplement, not replace, the earlier affidavit. Questions numbered to continue from Q59.

**60. Q:** Mr. Zschoche, you executed a Judicial Affidavit on 23 January 2026. Are there statements in it you wish to correct? 
**A:** Yes. In the Statement of Purposes, items (g) and (h), the date of the sale should read September 29, 2016, not September 26, 2019, consistent with Exhibit "H" and my answers to Questions 35 and 37. In my answers to Questions 11 and 12, the area of the larger parcel should read 28,891 square meters, not 28,981, consistent with Exhibit "B". These were typographical errors.

**61. Q:** When did you personally learn that the subject property had been sold to defendant Gloria Balane? 
**A:** In late 2022. The Deed of Absolute Sale, the Deed of Confirmation and the related instruments were registered on T-52540 only on November 23, 2021, as shown in Exhibits "B-1" to "B-4". After I learned of the sale, my mother executed an Affidavit of Adverse Claim (Exhibit "I"), counsel sent a demand (Exhibits "J" and "J-1"), and this case was filed.

**62. Q:** Did your mother or her sisters receive any part of the ₱250,000.00 stated in the Deed of Absolute Sale? 
**A:** No. None of the co-owners received any part of it.

**63. Q:** Did you know Cesar de la Fuente personally? 
**A:** Yes. I was in the Philippines in 1996 and met him then.

**64. Q:** Have you ever seen the owner's duplicate certificate of TCT No. T-52540? 
**A:** No. To my knowledge it was never in my mother's or her sisters' possession.

**65. Q:** I am showing you a Subdivision Agreement dated 3 August 1993 and registered on TCT No. T-4497 on 20 August 1993. Do you recognize it? 
**A:** Yes. It is the subdivision agreement executed by Cesar de la Fuente as attorney-in-fact, which names the persons with whom he was then transacting: [names as in the certified copy]. Gloria Balane is not among them. _[Mark as Exhibit "R". Include only if a certified copy is attached.]_

**66. Q:** Do you affirm the rest of your Judicial Affidavit of 23 January 2026? 
**A:** Yes, subject to the corrections I have stated.
